Its advertising operation track record is also evaluated externally: in the "Google Partners Program" it has been certified as the top-tier "Premier Partner" for 5 consecutive years from 2022 to 2026, and from LINE Yahoo Corporation it has received, since 2024, certification as a "Sales Partner 'Select'."
entries.ff236dde8002160f: Under the corporate philosophy 'Create services that are useful to customers and society by utilizing web marketing and SalesTech,' the company is centered on the Web Marketing Business and the Cloud SalesTech Business, and is working to strengthen a structure that supports the process from attracting customers to receiving orders and closing deals on a one-stop basis, aiming to become an indispensable company in society.
